name: Next.js
experience: I reach for Next.js whenever a project needs a web dashboard or a marketing site that has to actually rank in search — the Clyx Order admin dashboard, NIVXTIME's public site, and NAWA Holding's corporate site are all built on it.
whyChosen: Server components and the App Router let me keep dashboards fast without hand-rolling data fetching patterns, and built-in SEO primitives matter for public-facing sites like NAWA's.
